name: tch-activity
description: A box above the prompt that says what Claude is doing right now (reading, thinking, running a tool, waiting for you) in tail-claude-hud's icons and colors, and expands to show what it has done.

binary.title: tail-claude-hud binary
binary.description: Path to the tail-claude-hud binary the box reads its look from. Empty: ~/go/bin/tail-claude-hud when it exists, else tail-claude-hud on the PATH.

preset.title: tail-claude-hud preset
preset.description: The --preset your statusLine command passes to tail-claude-hud (a preset name or TOML path), so the box reads the same look. Empty: none.
